userStories.title: Add story_output_chunks PostgreSQL table migration
userStories.description: Create a new PostgreSQL migration that adds the story_output_chunks table. The table stores per-story filtered prose output chunks keyed by (run_id, story_id, sequence). This is the persistence layer that the story-log-follower writes to and the SSE stream endpoint reads from.

UNIQUE constraint on (run_id, story_id, sequence) prevents duplicate chunks
Composite index on (run_id, story_id, sequence) exists for efficient range queries
Migration runs cleanly via pg-index.ts migration runner without errors
npx tsc --noEmit in backend/ passes with no type errors after migration is added

userStories.title: Create story-log-follower.ts WAL subscriber service
userStories.description: Implement backend/src/lib/story-log-follower.ts. This service subscribes to the SSE hub and reacts to WAL events: on story_started it extracts log_file from payload, starts a 200ms file-tail loop, applies stream-json→prose extraction (parse JSON lines, extract event.message.content[].text from assistant events, pass non-JSON lines through verbatim), and writes prose chunks to story_output_chunks with monotonic per-(run_id,story_id) sequence numbers. On story_passed/failed/skipped it drains remaining bytes from the log file and stops the tail loop for that story.
acceptanceCriteria: StoryLogFollower class exported from story-log-follower.ts with start() and stop() methods
On story_started WAL event with payload containing log_file, run_id, story_id: starts a setInterval(200ms) tail loop reading new bytes from log_file using a file offset tracker

Stream-json lines with type=assistant are parsed and event.message.content[].text blocks are concatenated into prose; non-JSON lines pass through verbatim; lines with no extractable text are silently skipped
Prose chunks are written to story_output_chunks via INSERT with monotonic sequence numbers tracked per (run_id, story_id) in memory
On story_passed/story_failed/story_skipped WAL events: performs one final drain read of remaining log bytes then clears the tail interval for that (run_id, story_id)
npx tsc --noEmit in backend/ passes with no type errors

userStories.title: Add server startup recovery for in-flight stories in story-log-follower
userStories.description: Extend StoryLogFollower with a recover() method that runs on server startup. It queries WAL events for story_started events that have no matching story_passed/failed/skipped completion event on currently running pipeline_runs (status='running'). For each in-flight story found, it resumes tailing from where story_output_chunks left off (last sequence number + 1) using the log_file path from the story_started payload.
acceptanceCriteria: recover() method on StoryLogFollower queries: SELECT wal_events for type=story_started WHERE run_id IN (SELECT id FROM pipeline_runs WHERE status='running') AND no matching completion event exists in wal_events for the same (run_id, story_id)
For each recovered story, reads MAX(sequence) FROM story_output_chunks WHERE run_id=$1 AND story_id=$2 to determine resume offset
Resumes tail loop from the correct byte offset in the log file (derived from existing chunk count and sizes, or falls back to offset=0 if story_output_chunks is empty for that story)
Logs recovered story count at startup: 'StoryLogFollower: recovered N in-flight stories'
If log_file path in WAL payload does not exist on disk, logs warning and skips that story without crashing
npx tsc --noEmit in backend/ passes with no type errors

suggestedSkills.name: database-optimization
suggestedSkills.reason: Efficient query to find in-flight stories across wal_events and pipeline_runs

userStories.title: Add GET /api/pipeline/runs/:runId/stories/:storyId/stream SSE endpoint
userStories.description: Add a new SSE endpoint to pipeline.ts that serves filtered prose for a single story. It first replays all existing story_output_chunks rows for (run_id, story_id) as base64-encoded binary events. Then it polls for new rows every 200ms and emits them. It also calls emitSemanticSteps() on prose lines to emit semantic_step SSE events for tool use/read/write patterns. The endpoint terminates when the story has a completion WAL event (story_passed/failed/skipped). If story_output_chunks has 0 rows for this (run_id, story_id), it falls back to startTailing() the raw log file directly (same behavior as the existing /log endpoint) so the terminal never goes blank.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/pipeline/runs/:runId/stories/:storyId/stream is mounted in pipeline.ts with @swagger JSDoc annotation
Endpoint sets Content-Type: text/event-stream and sends SSE-formatted events with event:output data:<base64chunk>
Replays all existing story_output_chunks rows before entering the live poll loop (replay phase completes before first live poll tick)
Poll interval is 200ms; each tick queries SELECT chunk FROM story_output_chunks WHERE run_id=$1 AND story_id=$2 AND sequence > $3 ORDER BY sequence
Endpoint terminates (res.end()) when a story_passed/failed/skipped WAL event for the matching run_id+story_id is detected AND the poll has caught up to the last written sequence
If COUNT(*) FROM story_output_chunks WHERE run_id=$1 AND story_id=$2 = 0 after initial check, falls back to reading and streaming the raw log file path from the story_started WAL event payload
npx tsc --noEmit in backend/ passes with no type errors

=== GLOBAL STANDARDS (L1) ===
principles:
  typescript:
    strict_mode: true
    target: ES2022
    no_any: "Avoid `any` — use `unknown` with type guards or explicit generics"
    async_first: "All DB calls, LLM calls, and I/O are async — always await"

  error_handling:
    pattern: "AppError class hierarchy with immutable HTTP status codes"
    subclasses: [ValidationError 400, AuthError 401, ForbiddenError 403, NotFoundError 404, ConflictError 409, UnprocessableError 422]
    serialization: "{ error: string, code?: string, details?: Record<string, unknown> }"
    rule: "Throw from route handlers; centralized errorHandler middleware catches and serializes"

  database:
    driver: "pg Pool (async, connection pooling)"
    helpers: "query<T>() returns T[], queryOne<T>() returns T|undefined, execute() returns { rowCount }"
    placeholders: "$1, $2, ... (numbered, NOT positional ?)"
    transactions: "transaction<T>(fn) wraps in BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK"
    migrations: "SQL files in pg-migrations/, timestamp prefix YYYYMMDDHHMMSS for new files, tracked in schema_migrations"
    slow_query_logging: "Queries > 500ms logged with sanitized params"

  validation:
    library: zod
    pattern: "Middleware factories — validateBody(schema), validateQuery(schema), validateParams(schema)"
    method: "safeParse (not .parse() which throws)"
    response: "{ error: firstIssueMessage, details: zodError.issues }"

  llm:
    return_type: "ChatResult { text: string, usage: { inputTokens, outputTokens } }"
    rule: "Always use .text accessor — never treat ChatResult as a string"
    providers: "Multi-provider routing via model registry — claude-cli, anthropic, openai-compat, openrouter"

  api_design:
    documentation: "JSDoc @swagger annotations on every route → auto-generated OpenAPI spec"
    pagination: "{ items: T[], total: number, hasMore: boolean, cursor?: string }"
    response_shape: "Success: res.json(data). Error: { error, code, details } via AppError"
    middleware_chain: "validateBody(schema) → authRequired → async handler"
    security_headers: "helmet (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, noSniff, referrerPolicy)"
    caching: "Cache-Control: no-store on all responses, etag: false"

  testing:
    backend: "Jest with ts-jest, serial (maxWorkers: 1), 30s timeout, PG_POOL_SIZE=1"
    frontend: "Vitest with jsdom, globals: true"
    rule: "Always clean up DB pool connections in afterAll()"

  code_style:
    no_over_engineering: "Only make changes that are directly requested or clearly necessary"
    no_premature_abstraction: "Three similar lines > premature helper function"
    minimal_containers: "Don't add docstrings, comments, or type annotations to code you didn't change"
    security_first: "Never commit .env files, API keys, or secrets. Use vault for sensitive values."

=== PROJECT CONTEXT (L3) ===
name: rorca
type: web-app
purpose: AI spec orchestration platform that converts plain-English briefs into structured user story specs and autonomously executes them story-by-story via isolated agent subprocesses (claude, opencode, or codex)

stack:
  - React 18
  - TypeScript 5.7 (strict)
  - Vite 5
  - Tailwind CSS 3
  - xterm.js (@xterm/xterm)
  - react-router-dom 7
  - framer-motion
  - recharts
  - Express.js
  - PostgreSQL 16 (pg pool, pgvector, Apache AGE)
  - pg-boss (job queue)
  - Node.js >= 20
  - tsx (TypeScript runner)
  - Jest (backend tests)
  - Vitest (frontend tests)
  - Playwright (E2E)

key_modules:
  - src/panels/ — 5 primary UI panels (Specs, Runs, Analytics, Direction, Settings)
  - src/components/ — shared UI (Sidebar, RunTerminal, CommandPalette, slide-overs)
  - src/contexts/ — WorkspaceContext, AuthContext, ThemeContext, ToastContext
  - backend/src/routes/ — 32 Express route files
  - backend/src/lib/ — core services (sse-hub, direction-stack, llm-client, execution-engine, context-router, workspace-echolocation, rate-limiter, scheduler)
  - backend/src/worker.ts — pg-boss worker process (pipeline job consumer)
  - backend/src/lib/execution-engine.ts — sole execution engine for all agent types
  - backend/src/db/ — PostgreSQL pool, migration runner, 70+ migrations
  - backend/src/mcp/ — MCP stdio server (24 tools)
  - forge/ — spec JSON files, run-loop.sh bash fallback, self-register script

constraints:
  - Migrations must use timestamp format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS for new files (sequential 001-079 already exist)
  - Worker process must be running for pipeline triggers to execute
  - AGE search_path must be restored after every graph query
  - Auth middleware is globally disabled (intentional, local tool)
  - CLAUDE_BIN full path required for child process spawning (NVM PATH not inherited)
  - spec id is always the filename slug, never the human title

=== SPEC BRIEF (L4) ===
Fix mini-terminals in wave parallel runs showing raw Claude stream-json instead of filtered prose. The root cause: execution-engine writes to two paths — (1) logStream.write(chunk) which writes raw stream-json to per-story log files on disk, and (2) process.stdout.write(text) which writes filtered prose (extracted from stream-json assistant.content[].text blocks) to the worker's stdout, which then gets stored in run_output_chunks. Mini-terminals (MiniTerminalPane.tsx) connect to GET /api/pipeline/runs/:runId/stories/:storyId/log which tails the raw log file — so they see unfiltered stream-json with cache_read_input_tokens, modelUsage, tool_use JSON objects etc. The main terminal connects to GET /api/pipeline/runs/:runId/output which reads from run_output_chunks (filtered prose) — so it shows human-readable text.

Fix: Add a new story_output_chunks PostgreSQL table (id BIGSERIAL PK, run_id BIGINT FK pipeline_runs ON DELETE CASCADE, story_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, chunk BYTEA NOT NULL, sequence INT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(run_id, story_id, sequence), index on (run_id, story_id, sequence)). Create backend/src/lib/story-log-follower.ts — a WAL subscriber service that on story_started WAL events extracts the log_file path from payload, starts a 200ms file-tail loop, applies the same stream-json→prose extraction as execution-engine.ts (parse JSON lines, extract event.message.content[].text from assistant events, pass non-JSON lines through), writes prose chunks to story_output_chunks with monotonic per-(run_id,story_id) sequence. On story_passed/failed/skipped: drains final bytes and stops. On server startup: recovers in-flight stories by querying WAL for story_started without matching completion event on running pipeline_runs. Register the follower in server.ts alongside marker-injector. Add GET /api/pipeline/runs/:runId/stories/:storyId/stream SSE endpoint — replays story_output_chunks rows (base64 chunk + emitSemanticSteps for semantic_step events), then polls for new rows every 200ms, terminates when story is done, falls back to startTailing() log file if story_output_chunks has 0 rows for this (run_id, story_id). Update MiniTerminalPane.tsx to connect to /stream instead of /log. Keep /log endpoint unchanged for backward compat.
